scope: Proposition 4.6 (Integral representation) of the manuscript “A Linear Clock for Random Walk on Tree-Weighted Planar Maps” (preprints/A-Linear-Clock-for-Random-Walk-on-Tree-Weighted-Planar-Maps-October-5-2026/linear-clock-random-walk-tree-weighted-planar-maps.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0acb1c84bf79e9c8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 32-33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In every ordinary chart there is a measurable symmetric matrix field A, locally bounded and uniformly positive definite on smaller charts, such that, for every open U and every u ∈ C(U), F(u, U) =    Z U ∇uT A∇u dz, u ∈ W1,2 loc (U), +∞, u / ∈ W1,2 loc (U). (4.5) 32 The integral is allowed to be infinite. There is an analogous field A∗ for the dual functional.
